integrity: The full analytic proof and reproducible independent numerical/symbolic checks are included. No publication-priority or external audit certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complete instantaneous exogenous resetting of position and heading in a planar harmonic active Brownian model; only long-run signed alignment is optimized. A fixed-mean low-interval optimum is a supremum, not attained by strictly positive clocks; reset costs and adaptive protocols are excluded. Numerical constants are approximate.
title: A sharp fixed-mean reset-clock transition for active Brownian alignment
